senses.gloss:
शृकाल शृकाल, अस्, m. (for शृगाल below),
a jackal.

सृकाल सृकाल, अस्, m. (= शृकाल), a jackal;
[cf. सृगाल.]

सृक, अस्, m. air, wind; an arrow; a thunderbolt
(= वज्र, Naigh. II. 20); a lotus (= कैरव,
पद्म).
—सृका-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, probably holding
an arrow.
—सृका-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having an
arrow in the hand.

सृक्क सृक्क, अम्, n. (probably fr. rt. 1. सृज्
below; according to Sāy. फेनस्य स्रष्टृ, ‘the
emitter of saliva’), the corner of the mouth.

सृकण्डु सृ-कण्डु, उस्, f. (see कण्डु), the
itch, itching.

सृक्कणी, f. (according to Śabda-k.) the corner of
the mouth.

सृक्कन्, अ, n. the corner of the mouth; (अणी),
n. du. the two corners of the mouth.

सृक्किन्, इ, n. the corner of the mouth; (इणी), n.
du. the two corners of the mouth, (but according to
Śabda-k. the crude form is सृक्कि.)

सृक्वणी, f. (according to Śabda-k.) = सृक्कणी
above.

सृक्वन्, अ, n. = सृक्कन् above, (in Ṛg-veda I.
164, 28. and Atharva-veda IX. 10, 6. the form सृ-
क्वाणम्, acc. masc., occurs; this is by some trans-
lated ‘the mouth,’ but according to Sāy. ‘the corner
of the mouth;’ according to Yāska, Nirukta XI. 42,
= सरण); (अणी), n. du. the two corners of the
mouth.

सृक्विणी, f. (according to Śabda-k.) = सृक्कणी
above.

सृक्विन्, इ, n. = सृक्किन् above; (इणी), n. du. the
two corners of the mouth (according to Śabda-k.
the crude form is सृक्वि).

सृक्कृ सृक्-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make
the inarticulate sound सृक्.
